create_RHDReader_training: create an RHDReader instance in training mode with shuffle enabled and crop noise
create_RHDReader_evaluation: create an RHDReader instance in evaluation mode for hand pose inference
get_data_dict: call get on an RHDReader to retrieve a 320x320 image crop data dictionary
review_RHDReader_init: review the RHDReader constructor that loads pickle annotations and parses left and right hand keypoints
run_RHDReader_visualization: run the RHDReader main block to visualize 2D and 3D hand keypoints with PAF
